name: P.F. Chang's
notes: Dinner on 6 October 2026: a ceiling of pink blossom, red leather booths, and a table that kept filling up with small dishes.
ratingNote: Good food, good ambience, and a ceiling worth looking up at.

name: Daksina Bhawan
notes: A South Indian restaurant where the ceiling is hung with brass temple bells, a mural of a temple and an elephant fills one wall, and the dosa comes with sambar and a row of chutneys.
ratingNote: The benne dosa is the star. The idli is good too, and the filter coffee is great.

name: Costa Coffee
notes: On the third floor of Ambience Mall (NH8, Ambience Island, DLF Phase 3, Sector 24, Gurugram). A long wall with a big coffee mural, oval mirrors glowing yellow, and a cold serene caramel frappe with a slice of cheesecake.
ratingNote: The coffee is great, the cheesecake is good, and the ambience and café theme are both good.

name: NY United Cafe
notes: On the ground floor of Tower B, M3M Urbana Business Park, Sector 67, Gurugram, in the building where I work. Samosa chaat, chai, and their own walking tacos: blue Lay's piled with vegetables and sauces, with a veg tikka patty or paneer.
ratingNote: The samosa chaat is so tasty, and the walking tacos are so good.

name: Shikarbagh Restaurant
notes: At Hotel Narain Niwas Palace, Rambagh, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302004. We ordered so much food and drinks here, and all of it was so good. It is also where I met my bhabhi in person for the first time.
ratingNote: All the food is so good, the drinks are good too, and the ambience is so good, especially at night.

name: Punjab Grill
notes: Shop 19, Ground Floor, DLF Cyberhub, Gurugram. A North-West Frontier and Punjabi restaurant. We had soya chaap, garlic naan, butter naan, paneer lababdar, and the peach iced tea and cold coffee.
ratingNote: The food is crazy good and the ambience is decent. A refreshing pan shot at the end was the cherry on top.

name: Skyhouse Bar & Kitchen
coverAlt: The ceiling and bar of a dark venue: beams and ducts lit blue, clusters of glowing glass cubes hanging at the left, two small Indian flags above a black espresso machine, and shelves of bottles lit amber at the right, over a wooden panel with a warm strip of light
notes: Logix City Centre, Noida Rd, Wave City Center, Sector 32, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301. A fancy dinner after a day at my cousin's in Noida and a night at the movies. It was a good day.
ratingNote: A good day, and Skyhouse was a big part of it. The ambience is great and the food is also good.

name: Brunatos
notes: LG shop no. 28, 29, Queens Corner, 30, Queens Rd, D Block, Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302021. Hand crafted pizza. We had the Bianca al Formaggio pizza and the all fruit and berries mojito.
ratingNote: The Bianca al Formaggio is so tasty that I can't forget it yet: the cheese, the bake, everything about it. The all fruit and berries mojito is tasty and refreshing, and the ambience is modern and aesthetic.

name: Bento B
coverAlt: A table seen from above: a black bento box of small bowls beside a white tray of rice, fritters and watermelon, a bowl of dark curry, two red drinks, and a bowl of ramen with two fried eggs at the right
notes: 1st Floor, KK Square, C-11, Prithviraj Rd, C Scheme, Ashok Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302001. Right beside the Crossword bookstore, so I went into the store first, had something to read for a while, and then enjoyed the meal. We had dumpling soup, a Japanese katsu curry bento box, creamy miso ramen and Japanese cheesecake.
ratingNote: The bento box is a 5/5, the noodles are very tasty and authentic, and so is the dumpling soup. The Japanese cheesecake at the end is so soft and so good. A must try.
